tf_only.aws_organizations_tag: a tagging-only wrapper for an AWS Organizations resource (account, OU, or root) created outside Terraform's own management - e.g. an account implicitly created by AWS Control Tower - with no cloud resource of its own (registry.terraform.io: "Manages an individual Organizations resource tag ... in cases where Organizations resources are created outside Terraform")
tf_only.aws_quicksight_ingestion: an invocation action: starts a QuickSight dataset ingestion (SPICE refresh) job and tracks its result, with no CFN resource of its own (registry search: AWS::QuickSight has no Ingestion type)

cfn_unmodeled.aws_lex_intent: Lex V1 intent. AWS::Lex::Bot's own CFN doc states plainly: "Amazon Lex V2 is the only supported version in CloudFormation" - the registry's four Lex types (Bot, BotAlias, BotVersion, ResourcePolicy) are all V2-shaped (BotLocales/Intents/Slots are properties of AWS::Lex::Bot, not importable types); V1's standalone intent has no CFN counterpart at any version
cfn_unmodeled.aws_lex_slot_type: Lex V1 slot type - same V2-only CFN gap as aws_lex_intent above
cfn_unmodeled.aws_licensemanager_association: associates a License Manager configuration with an existing resource (AMI, launch template, EC2 host) via UpdateLicenseSpecificationsForResource; registry search: AWS::LicenseManager only has Grant, License and LicenseAssetRuleSet, no association/specification type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_licensemanager_license_configuration: a License Configuration (the license-counting-rules object). registry search: AWS::LicenseManager has no LicenseConfiguration type (only Grant, License, LicenseAssetRuleSet)
cfn_unmodeled.aws_lightsail_bucket_access_key: generated S3-compatible access-key credential for a Lightsail bucket. AWS::Lightsail::Bucket's full property list (AccessRules, BucketName, BundleId, ObjectVersioning, ReadOnlyAccessAccounts, ResourcesReceivingAccess, Tags) has no AccessKeys property - unlike AWS::IAM::AccessKey, Lightsail bucket keys are not CFN-declarable
cfn_unmodeled.aws_lightsail_disk_attachment: AWS::Lightsail::Disk exposes AttachedTo/AttachmentState/IsAttached only as Fn::GetAtt read-only attributes, not as settable Properties - the attach action itself is not something a CFN template can declare
cfn_unmodeled.aws_lightsail_key_pair: registry search: no AWS::Lightsail::KeyPair type exists at all (the 15 Lightsail registry types are Alarm, Bucket, Certificate, Container, Database, DatabaseSnapshot, Disk, DiskSnapshot, Distribution, Domain, Instance, InstanceSnapshot, LoadBalancer, LoadBalancerTlsCertificate, StaticIp)
cfn_unmodeled.aws_macie2_classification_export_configu: per-account setting for where Macie writes classification results. registry search: AWS::Macie only has AllowList, CustomDataIdentifier, FindingsFilter, Session - no export-configuration type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_macie2_classification_job: registry search: AWS::Macie has no ClassificationJob type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_macie2_member: Macie member-account association. registry search: AWS::Macie has no Member type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_macie2_organization_admin_account: registry search: AWS::Macie has no OrganizationAdminAccount type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_macie2_organization_configuration: registry search: AWS::Macie has no OrganizationConfiguration type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_main_route_table_association: designates an existing route table as a VPC's main route table (EC2's ReplaceRouteTableAssociation on the implicit main association). AWS::EC2::VPC carries no MainRouteTableId-style property, and the registry has no resource type for this association (only AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation exists, for subnet-level associations) - a well-known CloudFormation gap
cfn_unmodeled.aws_memorydb_snapshot: registry search: AWS::MemoryDB has ACL, Cluster, MultiRegionCluster, ParameterGroup, SubnetGroup, User - no Snapshot type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_neptune_cluster_endpoint: a custom/reader endpoint on a Neptune cluster. registry search: AWS::Neptune has DBCluster, DBClusterParameterGroup, DBInstance, DBParameterGroup, DBSubnetGroup, EventSubscription, GlobalCluster - no ClusterEndpoint type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_neptune_cluster_snapshot: registry search: AWS::Neptune has no DBClusterSnapshot type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_networkfirewall_resource_policy: cross-account resource-based policy attached to a Firewall/FirewallPolicy/RuleGroup ARN via PutResourcePolicy. registry search: AWS::NetworkFirewall has Firewall, FirewallPolicy, LoggingConfiguration, RuleGroup, TLSInspectionConfiguration, VpcEndpointAssociation - no ResourcePolicy type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_networkflowmonitor_scope: registry search: AWS::NetworkFlowMonitor has only a Monitor type, no Scope type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_networkmanager_connection: the classic (non-Cloud-WAN) device-to-device Connection object within a global network. registry search: AWS::NetworkManager's 16 types (ConnectAttachment, ConnectPeer, CoreNetwork*, CustomerGatewayAssociation, Device, DirectConnectGatewayAttachment, GlobalNetwork, Link, LinkAssociation, Site, SiteToSiteVpnAttachment, TransitGateway*, VpcAttachment) include no Connection type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_networkmanager_transit_gateway_conne: registers an already-existing Transit Gateway Connect peer with a device/link in a global network (confirmed via provider docs: "Associates a transit gateway Connect peer with a device"). registry search: AWS::NetworkManager has a ConnectPeer type (for creating SD-WAN Connect peers) but no separate association type for registering a TGW Connect peer
cfn_unmodeled.aws_networkmonitor_monitor: registry search: no AWS::NetworkMonitor::* type exists at all (distinct from AWS::NetworkFlowMonitor, which is a different service)
cfn_unmodeled.aws_networkmonitor_probe: same as aws_networkmonitor_monitor - no AWS::NetworkMonitor::* type in the registry
cfn_unmodeled.aws_observabilityadmin_telemetry_evaluat: an account-level telemetry-configuration evaluation run. registry search: AWS::ObservabilityAdmin's 6 types (OrganizationCentralizationRule, OrganizationTelemetryRule, S3TableIntegration, TelemetryEnrichment, TelemetryPipelines, TelemetryRule) have no Evaluation type
the organization-wide counterpart of aws_observabilityadmin_telemetry_evaluation - same registry gap, no Evaluation type at any scope
cfn_unmodeled.aws_notifications_organizations_access: enables the User Notifications service's organizational access (trusted-access-style toggle). registry search: AWS::Notifications' 9 types (ChannelAssociation, EventRule, ManagedNotification*, NotificationConfiguration, NotificationHub, OrganizationalUnitAssociation, NotificationsContacts::EmailContact) have no OrganizationsAccess type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_opensearch_authorize_vpc_endpoint_ac: grants another account permission to create a VPC endpoint into a domain (AuthorizeVpcEndpointAccess). registry search: AWS::OpenSearchService has only Application and Domain - no authorization/access type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_opensearch_outbound_connection: cross-cluster search connection. registry search: AWS::OpenSearchService has only Application and Domain
cfn_unmodeled.aws_opensearch_package: a custom plugin/dictionary package associated with a domain. registry search: AWS::OpenSearchService has only Application and Domain
cfn_unmodeled.aws_opensearch_package_association: same gap as aws_opensearch_package - no CFN type models package associations
cfn_unmodeled.aws_opensearch_vpc_endpoint: a PrivateLink-style VPC endpoint into a domain. registry search: AWS::OpenSearchService has only Application and Domain
cfn_unmodeled.aws_organizations_aws_service_access: enables trusted access for an AWS service at the organization level (EnableAWSServiceAccess). registry search: AWS::Organizations has Account, Organization, OrganizationalUnit, Policy, ResourcePolicy - no service-access type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_organizations_delegated_administrato: registers a member account as delegated administrator for a service. registry search: AWS::Organizations has no DelegatedAdministrator type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_osis_pipeline_endpoint: a VPC endpoint connection into an OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline. registry search: AWS::OSIS has only a Pipeline type, no endpoint type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_osis_resource_policy: cross-account resource policy for pipeline log ingestion. registry search: AWS::OSIS has only a Pipeline type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_outposts_capacity_task: an on-demand capacity-evaluation task run against an Outpost. registry search: AWS::Outposts has only a Site type (plus the unrelated AWS::S3Outposts::* family) - no CapacityTask type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_quicksight_account_settings: registry search: AWS::QuickSight's 18 types have no AccountSettings type (account-level singleton config, not CFN-modeled)
cfn_unmodeled.aws_quicksight_account_subscription: subscribes an AWS account to QuickSight (the one-time account-creation action). registry search: no AccountSubscription type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_quicksight_folder_membership: places an existing asset (dashboard, analysis, dataset...) into a folder. AWS::QuickSight::Folder's full property list (AwsAccountId, FolderId, FolderType, Name, ParentFolderArn, Permissions, SharingModel, Tags) has no members/membership property - registry search confirms no separate FolderMembership type either
cfn_unmodeled.aws_quicksight_group: a QuickSight identity-store group. registry search: no Group type (QuickSight groups are an identity construct managed by API, not CFN)
cfn_unmodeled.aws_quicksight_iam_policy_assignment: assigns an IAM policy to QuickSight users/groups. registry search: no IamPolicyAssignment type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_quicksight_ip_restriction: account-level IP allow-list singleton. registry search: no IpRestriction type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_quicksight_namespace: a QuickSight multi-tenancy namespace (identity construct). registry search: no Namespace type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_quicksight_role_custom_permission: assigns an existing CustomPermissions profile to an entire QuickSight role (ADMIN/AUTHOR/READER/...) within a namespace - confirmed via provider docs (role + namespace arguments, no permissions content of its own). registry search: no per-role assignment type; AWS::QuickSight::CustomPermissions models the permissions profile itself, not this assignment
cfn_unmodeled.aws_quicksight_role_membership: assigns a user to a QuickSight role. registry search: no RoleMembership type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_quicksight_template_alias: a named pointer to one version of an existing template - confirmed via provider docs (template_id + template_version_number, no template content of its own). registry search: AWS::QuickSight::Template exists but there is no TemplateAlias type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_quicksight_user: a QuickSight user (identity construct, typically federated via IAM/Identity Center). registry search: no User type
cfn_unmodeled.aws_quicksight_user_custom_permission: assigns a CustomPermissions profile to one specific user, the per-user counterpart of aws_quicksight_role_custom_permission. registry search: no per-user assignment type
